title: Launch ke baad pehle ye paanch jagah
content:
App launch kar diya, aur koi use hi nahi kar raha.
Har jagah post mat karo.
Pehle in paanch jagah daalo.

Number ek.
Reddit ka r/SideProject.
Yahan log naya app try karte hain.
Aur seedha batate hain, kya galat hai.

Number do.
Hacker News.
Show HN, link ke saath post karo.
Front page pe aa gaye, to ek din mein hazaron log dekh sakte hain.

Number teen.
Product Hunt.
Tuesday se Thursday sabse zyada traffic hota hai.
Competition bhi zyada hai.
Rank chahiye, to weekend try karo.

Number chaar.
Indie Hackers.
Yeh un logon ka adda hai jo tumhari tarah apps bana rahe hain.
Naye tools try karte rehte hain.

Number paanch.
Uneed.
Chhota platform hai.
Roz kam launches hote hain.
App pehle din dabege nahi.
Backlink bhi milta hai.

Paanchon ke links ki list maine bana li hai.
Comment karo, launch.
Main DM kar dunga.
